Manga Translator — third-party notices

PP-OCRv5 mobile text detection and recognition models and dictionaries:
PaddlePaddle / PaddleOCR contributors. Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
The asset installer pins the original ONNX exports and serializes the ordered
recognition dictionaries as JSON. Source identifiers and hashes are recorded in
scripts/model-sources.json in the source repository.

ONNX Runtime Web:
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. MIT License.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
See ONNX-Runtime-LICENSE.txt.
Additional upstream notices are available with the ONNX Runtime source.

Svelte:
MIT License. See Svelte-LICENSE.md.

Optional weights, when included by the person building this package:
- Panel detector exported by mednasserallah from AlekseyCalvin's YOLO26n
  Manga Panel Detector. The original model used the Manga109-s annotations.
  https://huggingface.co/mednasserallah/manga-panel-detector-yolo26n-onnx
- LaMa export by sapienkit from the original LaMa project by Suvorov et al.
  The training dataset referenced by the export is Places2.
  https://huggingface.co/sapienkit/LaMa-ONNX
Both export cards list Apache License 2.0. Refer to the pinned model cards for
upstream attribution and verify redistribution rights for the intended use.
